articles.title: Chiefs receiver Tyquan Thornton is out indefinitely after dislocating ankle in win over Raiders
articles.summary: Whether Thornton sustained the injury while being tackle or as he stood up to celebrate the catch, his left foot wasn't pointed in a natural direction.
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs receiver Tyquan Thornton suffered a gruesome ankle injury late in the fourth quarter of Week 4's 30-27 road win over the Las Vegas Raiders.

"It doesn't look good," Chiefs head coach Andy Reid told reporters postgame.

With the Chiefs trailing 19-17, Thornton caught a 55-yard pass from Patrick Mahomes on a post pattern, continuing what had been the most productive game of his career. Thornton was tackled by Raiders safety Treydan Stukes and immediately stood up to celebrate the big play. However, he then crumpled to the turf with his left foot turned in an unnatural direction as he sat on the ground.

Warning: Video of the injury is graphic.

Thornton flew home with the team and will be further evaluated in Kansas City, Reid said.

NFL Network reported Thornton dislocated his ankle, which was put back in place by doctors. He was reportedly "in good spirits" and will be sidelined indefinitely.

Thornton suffered the injury while being tackled, though it wasn't clear in live-action when he stood up. Perhaps adrenaline compelled him to celebrate the big play and reality quickly set in as his left foot touched the grass, but replay showed the ankle being dislocated durign the tackle.

Unable to put weight on his left leg, Thornton was carted off the field and taken to the locker room.

As could be expected, Thornton's teammates were upset after seeing how badly he was hurt and watching him require assistance to leave the game. When play resumed, Kenneth Walker scored on a 2-yard run to give Kansas City a 23-19 lead. A subsequent 2-point conversion attempt failed when Mahomes threw incomplete to Walker.

On the ensuing kickoff, Chiefs linebacker Jeffrey Bassa forced Raiders returner Dareke Young to fumble and the ball was recovered by Jack Cochrane at the Las Vegas 22-yard line. One play later, Walker rushed for his second touchdown in 19 seconds. Harrison Butker followed with the extra point for a 30-19 lead.

Thornton, 26, was developing into a reliable big-play threat for Mahomes and a Chiefs receiver corps thinned out by injuries. Rashee Rice left the game in the first quarter with a hamstring injury . Xavier Worthy has also been dealing with a shoulder injury, though he played Sunday, notching four receptions.

Because of the injuries, the Chiefs could explore a potential reunion with free-agent receiver Tyreek Hill, The Athletic's Michael Silver reported Sunday night.

Prior to his injury, Thornton caught five passes for 111 yards and two TDs, including an 8-yard scoring grab early in the fourth quarter.

"Just praying for him, You never want anyone to get injured and you're hoping it's better than it looked out there," Mahomes said to CBS' Tracy Wolfson after the game. "Praying for him and hopefully he comes back healthy."

Thornton missed final 3 games last season with concussion

This is the second consecutive season in which Thornton had to leave a game due to injury.

Last year in a Week 15 matchup with the Los Angeles Chargers, he suffered a concussion on a head-to-head hit by safety Tony Jefferson. Thornton missed the Chiefs' final three games as a result.

articles.title: "Very upsetting and struggled to understand": Gisele Bündchen reveals how she really feels about Tom Brady divorce
articles.summary: Gisele Bündchen appears to have reached a place of peace several years after her high-profile divorce from Tom Brady.
articles.body: Gisele Bündchen appears to have reached a place of peace several years after her high-profile divorce from Tom Brady. The former couple’s split once drew intense attention, but the supermodel is now looking back on their marriage with less pain and more gratitude. According to a source cited by People, Bündchen has no lingering bitterness toward her former husband and remains thankful for the family and memories they built together. Her perspective also comes as both stars have moved into very different chapters of their lives, with Bündchen rebuilding her family life and Brady continuing his career outside the NFL.Gisele Bündchen reflects on her divorce from Tom BradyBündchen and Brady ended their marriage in October 2022 after 13 years together. The decision marked the end of one of celebrity culture’s most closely followed relationships, but their children remained central to both parents.A source told People that Bündchen once expected the marriage to last for the rest of her life.“She always thought she would be married to Tom for the rest of her life,” an insider told People Tuesday. “The divorce was very upsetting, and she struggled to understand it at the time, but she’s not bitter.”The source also said the model remains thankful for the family they created.“The insider noted that the supermodel is “grateful for their children and the years they shared.”“She’s very spiritual and looking back, she feels the universe had another plan for her,” they added.The couple share two children, Benjamin and Vivian. Bündchen also became a stepmother to Brady’s eldest son, Jack, from his previous relationship with Bridget Moynahan.Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen moved on after marriageTheir divorce followed years of speculation about pressure within the relationship. Bündchen previously said they had “grown apart,” while a later account in Lars Anderson’s book, “Brady: An American Story and the Price of Greatness,” offered additional claims about tensions between the couple.The book alleges that Bündchen wanted Brady to devote more attention to their family and that she eventually told him, “We’re not compatible.”Those claims provide another perspective on a marriage that unfolded under constant public scrutiny. Still, Bündchen’s reported outlook today suggests she has chosen not to remain defined by the difficult ending.She married jujitsu instructor Joaquim Valente in December 2025, and the couple have welcomed a son. Brady, meanwhile, has been linked romantically to model Irina Shayk and internet personality Alix Earle.For Bündchen, the latest comments point to a different kind of closure. Rather than focusing on what ended, she appears more interested in appreciating what the relationship gave her, particularly her children and the years they shared.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Deshaun Watson mansion: Inside the $6.9M, 17,000 sq ft Hunting Valley home Cleveland Browns quarterback shares with wife Jilly Anais
articles.summary: Deshaun Watson is a Cleveland Browns quarterback. He signed a blockbuster contract with the franchise in March 2022: a five-year, $230 million deal.
articles.body: Deshaun Watson is a Cleveland Browns quarterback. He signed a blockbuster contract with the franchise in March 2022: a five-year, $230 million deal. He could have any house in Northeast Ohio, but he chose a conventional mansion in Hunting Valley.He purchased the sprawling private estate in October 2022 - back when sexual misconduct allegations against him were headlines, and he had just entered the Cleveland Browns franchise.The English-style home was listed for $6.9 million, but the NFL quarterback bought it for $5.4 million, as per reports. The estate spans roughly 5.79 acres, surrounded by rolling hills and untouched nature in Hunting Valley, while the mansion covers 17,000 sq. ft.The most controversial quarterback married Jilly Anais in Miami in July 2025. He lives with the Sports Illustrated swimsuit model in the posh Cleveland-area residence.Deshaun Watson’s Cleveland Ohio mansion comes with exclusive and luxurious featuresDeshaun Watson’s high-end mansion was built in 2006. It underwent extensive renovations in 2021, just before Watson acquired it in 2022.As per listing agent David Ayers of the Young Team at Keller Williams Greater Metropolitan in Pepper Pike, the English-style home is “the most prestigious and remarkable property in the region.” Majestic Steel CEO Todd Leebow was the seller who listed the property for $6.9 million. He bought it for $4.7 million in 2017.Inside, the 17,241-sq-ft manor boasts five bedrooms, six and a half bathrooms, and multiple spaces designed both for relaxation and entertainment.The lavishly designed estate features a gourmet kitchen, office and media room, a second laundry room, a swimming pool, tennis and volleyball courts, a stocked fishing pond, multiple patios, and a fitness room measuring close to 3,000 sq ft. A carriage house on the property provides parking and additional living space.The abode also includes a separate cigar area and a tasting room for entertaining purposes. From that fourth-floor cigar and tasting room, one can access a terrace and rooftop lookout with breathtaking views of the surrounding hills and river valley.One of the house’s most luxurious spaces is its lower-level entertainment area. The club level comprises a 12-seat theater, gaming area, lounge, walkout patio, and full bar. It creates a perfect setup for movie nights to larger gatherings. It could be Watson’s favorite corner of the house.The primary master suite is particularly expansive, featuring a private bathroom, dressing room, and office. A simple bedroom space could offer so much when re-imagined with multiple dedicated areas within the suite itself.A six-car garage adds the cherry on top in terms of the estate’s functionality.A combination of personalized recreational facilities and indoor entertainment services gives the multi-million mansion a resort-like character. And it doesn’t even touch the traditionality of its English-style architecture - blending modernity with history.Deshaun Watson’s Houston mansionDeshaun Watson previously lived in Houston. The 5,264 sq-foot dwelling boasted five bedrooms and five bathrooms. The humble abode was surrounded by lush greenery and featured a resort-style backyard pool.From the main entrance, guests entered an expansive living room with large windows and a stylish fireplace. The chef’s kitchen featured marble countertops and state-of-the-art appliances.The primary suite featured a statement window, a large walk-in closet, and two cozy seating areas. The bathroom featured double vanities and elegant tiled flooring. The mansion also consisted of a large home theater with a projector and comfy chairs. Outside, a grill and cozy seating area offered peace and privacy.Deshaun Watson bought the Houston mansion for $1.8 million, as per the Realtor website. He listed the abode for $1.65 million in 2017, but later withdrew it in January 2018.The NFL quarterback listed it again for $1.8 million in February 2025. By June 2025, he reduced the price to $1.65 million. He finally found a buyer, according to a Realtor.com article from August 2025.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Hailee Steinfeld reveals the surprising way Josh Allen’s NFL schedule affects their family
articles.summary: Hailee Steinfeld and Josh Allen are learning how to make family life work around one of the most demanding calendars in professional sport.
articles.body: Hailee Steinfeld and Josh Allen are learning how to make family life work around one of the most demanding calendars in professional sport. Since welcoming their daughter Harper Haize Allen in April, the couple’s routines have taken on a new rhythm. Steinfeld has found a way to shape her acting commitments around Josh’s Buffalo Bills schedule, giving her more time with him during the NFL season. When football pauses, however, the balance shifts again. Her career becomes busier, while the couple adjusts to the very different pace of life that comes with raising a young child.Hailee Steinfeld adjusts to Josh Allen’s NFL scheduleFor Steinfeld, the NFL season has become more than a backdrop to her relationship with Allen. It now helps determine how she organises her own professional life.Unlike Allen, whose football calendar gives him a clear structure for much of the year, Steinfeld has greater flexibility as an actress. She has used that freedom to make herself available during the season and spend more time supporting the Bills quarterback.That arrangement gives the couple a rare chance to settle into a predictable routine. Steinfeld can step away from the fast pace of Hollywood for a while, while Allen focuses on the demands of an NFL campaign.The pattern changes once the season ends. Steinfeld’s acting commitments pick up, creating a natural switch in their household schedule. Rather than forcing both careers into the same routine, the couple appears to have found a way to work with the differences.Hailee Steinfeld and Josh Allen embrace life as parentsTheir daughter Harper Haize Allen has added another layer to that balancing act. The couple welcomed their first child in April 2026, and Steinfeld later revealed their daughter’s name through the Beau Society newsletter in June.Motherhood has also changed Steinfeld’s approach to everyday life. The early months have brought the familiar mix of joy, exhaustion and adjustment that comes with caring for a newborn. Her experience has encouraged her to slow down and accept that not every day needs to move at the same pace.Allen has also spoken about the impact of fatherhood on his routine. Sleep has become more precious, with the NFL star trying to get to bed earlier as he adjusts to life with a newborn.The changes may sound simple, but they represent a major shift for two people with exceptionally busy careers. Football demands Allen’s attention for much of the year, while Steinfeld’s work can take her in different directions.For now, their approach is less about maintaining a perfect routine and more about adapting as their family grows. The result is a schedule shaped not only by football and Hollywood, but also by the needs of their daughter.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M Ohio mansion has a $1.75M architectural twin in Illinois
articles.summary: Travis Kelce’s new Ohio mansion has an unusual connection to another historic home nearly 400 miles away.
articles.body: Travis Kelce’s new Ohio mansion has an unusual connection to another historic home nearly 400 miles away. The Kansas City Chiefs star paid $5.35 million for Moyenage, a grand estate overlooking Lake Erie, but its history stretches beyond football and celebrity real estate. The mansion was designed for the same steel magnate who commissioned a strikingly similar house in Illinois several years earlier. Now, that architectural relative, the House of Seven Gables in Wheaton, is on the market for $1.75 million, offering buyers a rare chance to own a piece of the story behind Kelce’s impressive new property.Travis Kelce’s Ohio mansion has a historic architectural connectionKelce’s Bratenahl estate, known as Moyenage, stands out for its scale. The roughly 21,000-square-foot property sits on 3.5 acres overlooking Lake Erie and includes eight bedrooms, a game room, home theatre and a separate two-bedroom gatehouse.But the story behind the house makes the property even more intriguing.Architect Jarvis Hunt originally designed Moyenage for Chicago steel magnate Jay C. Morse around the start of the 20th century. Before that, Hunt had designed the House of Seven Gables in Wheaton, Illinois, for Morse in 1897.Jenny Ames of Engel & Völkers Chicago, who is representing the Illinois property with Lisa Grimes, said the connection is more than a coincidence.“The resemblance is really quite remarkable,”“Historical accounts indicate that when Morse later built Moyenage in Ohio, he asked Hunt to design it based on his Wheaton home,” Ames said. “So when you look at the two houses side by side, you are not simply seeing two homes by the same architect. You are seeing two versions of a very personal architectural vision created for the same owner.”Both properties showcase Tudor and Jacobean influences, with brick exteriors, steep gables, large chimneys and elaborate interiors.House of Seven Gables offers a smaller version of Kelce’s mansionThe Illinois home is considerably smaller than Kelce’s Ohio residence, covering about 10,000 square feet on less than half an acre. It has seven bedrooms, three floors and a newly built three-car garage.Inside, however, its historic character remains strong. Original fireplaces, oak panelling, carved woodwork, flooring, leaded glass and beamed ceilings have survived decades of changes.“The interiors are where the relationship becomes especially interesting,” Ames said. “Both homes have extraordinary woodwork, beamed ceilings, substantial staircases, leaded glass and formal rooms organized on a grand scale.”The property also has an unusual survival story. After serving as the Loretto Convent for decades, the mansion faced demolition during redevelopment. In 2017, workers moved the approximately 730-ton structure about 500 feet to a new site.“They moved the structure intact,” Ames said.The remarkable operation involved placing the mansion on steel beams and 21 hydraulic dollies before moving it onto a new foundation. The process reportedly took about six hours.For Kelce, Moyenage is now part of his growing real estate portfolio. For prospective buyers in Illinois, the House of Seven Gables offers something even more unusual: a chance to own the architectural predecessor of the Chiefs star’s historic Ohio retreat.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: NFL news, live updates: Lamar Jackson, Saquon Barkley, Ja'Marr Chase exit with injuries in Week 4
articles.summary: Follow along with the latest NFL news coming out of Week 4.
articles.body: Another NFL Sunday is in the books, with the Atlanta Falcons and New Orleans Saints still in the queue for "Monday Night Football" to close out Week 4.The day offered plenty of exciting matchups, including a thriller between the Dallas Cowboys and Houston Texans that saw Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb connect for the go-ahead touchdown with just 0:43 on the clock. It also offered plenty of injuries that NFL fans and fantasy football managers alike will be keeping a close eye on in the week to come.Several stars went down with injuries, headlined by Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson, who left the stadium in a walking boot after suffering an ankle injury in Sunday's win over the Tennessee Titans. Jackson is expected to undergo an MRI on Monday, per reports. Running back Saquon Barkley exited Week 4 with a hamstring injury, while Ja'Marr Chase was ruled out with a concussion after having his facemask grabbed before getting tackled by a defender. The Kansas City Chiefs lost two of their top receivers, too, as Rashee Rice went down with a hamstring issue and Tyquan Thornton suffered a gruesome ankle injury that seems likely to have ended his season. Per The Athletic's Michael Silver, the team has reached out to Tyreek Hill's agent about a possible reunion.Follow along with Yahoo Sports for the latest NFL news, injury updates and more coming out of Week 4.

articles.title: ESPN Insider Names Green Bay Packers Starter As Potential Trade Candidate to Watch
articles.summary: The Green Bay Packers have fallen well short of expectations to this point in the 2026 NFL season, prompting calls […]
articles.body:
The Green Bay Packers have fallen well short of expectations to this point in the 2026 NFL season, prompting calls from the fan base for a coaching change. While firing Matt LaFleur is unlikely, it does appear there's a chance of Green Bay operating as a mini-seller come trade season.

In an early preview of the 2026 NFL trade deadline, ESPN 's Dan Graziano mentioned Packers cornerback Keisean Nixon as a potential veteran who could be traded within the next month.

"The Packers, like the Chargers, did not expect to have a losing record at this point (or probably any point) of the season. They're dealing with massive injury issues, particularly on the offensive line — the type of thing that can make it very tough to right the ship after a difficult start. Nixon is 29 and in the final year of his contract. He has experience as a kick returner as well as cornerback, and an acquiring team would be on the hook for only a prorated portion of his $4.3 million 2026 salary." ESPN's Dan Graziano on why the Green Bay Packers may trade Keisean Nixon

"The Packers, like the Chargers, did not expect to have a losing record at this point (or probably any point) of the season. They're dealing with massive injury issues, particularly on the offensive line — the type of thing that can make it very tough to right the ship after a difficult start. Nixon is 29 and in the final year of his contract. He has experience as a kick returner as well as cornerback, and an acquiring team would be on the hook for only a prorated portion of his $4.3 million 2026 salary."

ESPN's Dan Graziano on why the Green Bay Packers may trade Keisean Nixon

Nixon, age 29, has served as Green Bay's No. 1 cornerback since last season and he's been a multi-year starter for the last four years. After earning first-team All-Pro honors as a returner (2022-23), he transitioned away from special teams in 2025 to focus exclusively on playing the perimeter and lining up against top receivers.

He earned his first Pro Bowl selection this past season, though that was largely a result of the number of players who declined to participate or were ruled out due to injury. While he got off to a strong start, he wound up allowing a 105.1 passer rating, 651 receiving yards and 6 touchdowns on 87 targets in coverage.

In a contract year, there has been no reporting since the summer that indicated Green Bay wanted to sign Nixon to a long-term extension. He also received some pushback from the Packers coaching staff during training camp and implied the team was punishing him .

Trading away a veteran starting cornerback has been done before by Packers general manager Brian Gutekunst. In October 2023 , Green Bay traded Rasul Douglas and a 2024 fifth-round pick to the Buffalo Bills in exchange for a third-round pick. The team finished with a 9-8 record, losing in the Divisional Round.

Keisean Nixon contract ( Spotrac ): $7.166 million cap hit in 2026

While Nixon isn't beloved by the fans in Green Bay because he hasn't performed like a No. 1 cornerback, he can be an effective No. 2 starter on a better defense. It also helps that he carries a relatively small cap hit relative to his role, which could make him more appealing now that Joey Porter Jr. is off the market.

Green Bay does have an experienced starter working behind Nixon and rookie Brandon Cisse as a backup right now in Carrington Valentine. However, the team is dangerously thin at the position beyond the trio. If Nixon is being traded within the next month, either the team is riding a five-game losing streak and sits at 2-7 or Cisse has emerged as a true No. 1 option and the team is comfortable putting Valentine back out there full-time. Right now, neither seems likely.
